backend_surface.proposed_for_be: Optional: ?action=beefy_feed&rails=<csv> returning {cards:[card,...]} per this schema, so FE can swap the karl_query fan-out for one batched call. FE ships working WITHOUT it (composition-over-karl_query). No new XP, no migrations.

card.description: One beefy home-feed card. kind=inference (Karl connected the dots) or discovery (a comrade found it). Fail-closed: figure + source required; unsourced numbers render nothing.

answer_html.note: may contain <b> for the glowing figure only; no other tags

deep_link.note: feed -> deep page (WS-C weave): the rail's deep_link

exhibit_rows.note: verified rows for the EXHIBIT section

figures.note: 1-3 tappable figures; each opens the drill-down sheet

live.note: true = bound to a live endpoint; false = curated anchor

question.note: the hook, second person, present tense

rail.note: one of the 9 rail keys above

source.note: receipts line, e.g. RECEIPTS — DOJ case files · LDA filings

feed_behavior.beefy_wave: Anchor cards (audited figures only) render below the seed feed in a MORE FROM THE RAILS section; live karl_query fan-out appends per-rail cards as they resolve; honest-empty per rail when nothing returns
feed_behavior.deploy_gating: Deploy count flips on share-sheet CONFIRM, never on tap (WS-D A1.4); no fake counters on new cards
feed_behavior.discoveries: Cards the visitor DEPLOYED are recorded (localStorage pf-my-finds) and re-surface as COMRADE FOUND cards mixed into the feed — Karl inferences + user discoveries, endless and alive
feed_behavior.inference_lead: Karl inference card leads on every load (existing behavior, unchanged)
feed_behavior.more_intel: MORE INTEL button appends the next wave with a 200ms crossfade (not a full shimmer replay); never auto-plays

figure_governance.rule: Only News-Desk-audited figures may be hardcoded (audit 2026-10-10 01:40 CDT). Everything else binds to live endpoints or ships blank.
